title: ST Policy In India History
definition: The historical evolution of Science and Technology (S&T) policy in post-independent India, focusing on institutional building, self-reliance, and aligning technological capabilities with socio-economic development goals.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims through chronological milestones of S&T policies (1958, 1983, 2003, 2020) and in Mains GS-3 under 'Awareness in the fields of IT, Space, Computers, robotics, nano-technology, bio-technology and issues relating to intellectual property rights'.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of ST Policy In India History.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of research and development (R&D) ecosystem
